disorder-name.detail: First Episode Drug Naïve Major Depressive Disorder (FEDN-MDD); diagnosed per DSM-5 criteria; drug naïve at the time of enrollment.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Two hundred seventy-four adults with FEDN-MDD and 832 healthy controls from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research were included."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Data sourced from the International Big-Data Center for Depression Research (IBCDR), collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR)."
